messages:
alicia: Heads-up — premerge pin exemption requested for runtime v3.2.1 to land the SDK hotpatch tonight. Failing longseq unit tests in canary only. @release-coordinator can we get a quick thumbs?

mike: What tests are failing exactly? Can you paste the minimal repro or logs? :eyes: 

alicia: repro is the longseq memory leak we saw last sprint. Minimal failing command: `pytest tests/integration/test_longseq.py::test_cache_eviction -k canary`

alicia: failing stack: ```
AssertionError: KV cache size grew by 3x after 200 steps
  File "server/kv_cache.py", line 214, in append
    assert size <= MAX_KV_SIZE
```

sarah: Reproduced locally on canary runtime pool. Doesn't happen on pinned runtime v3.1.8. Looks like a regression in the KV compaction path.

release-coordinator: I need decision: do we allow exemption (pin v3.1.8 for canary) so SDK hotpatch merges, or block until runtime fix? Nightshift folks will be oncall. 

oncall-rot1: Nightshift here. We can accept a temporary canary pin for 6 hours if deploybot has an automated rollback/clear schedule. Prefer limiting blast radius to eu-west and staging first.

deploybot: Deploybot report — current pinlist: {"canary":"runtime:v3.1.8","hosted":"runtime:v3.2.0"} 
Actionable: `pin runtime canary v3.1.8 --until 2026-11-03T06:30Z --scope eu-west,staging` will create a scheduled unpin. Confirm with `confirm pin` to proceed.

mike: Quick compatibility note: SDK hotpatch depends on kvcache API that changed in v3.2.1, but changes are backward-compatible for our path if runtime is v3.1.8? QA says yes but regression in v3.2.1 edge path triggers leak. 

qa-bot: Automated eval: promptset longseq-regress shows 0.8% error rate on v3.2.1, 0.03% on v3.1.8. Recommend hold.

alicia: If release-coordinator approves exemption we'll pin canary and proceed with SDK merge + canary rollout to staging. Then open runtime patch PR for v3.2.2 with KV compaction fix.

release-coordinator: OK — decision: temporary canary pin approved for 6h scoped to eu-west + staging. Mike, file the runtime patch and add regression test to longseq harness. Oncall, monitor token latency and memory metric `kv.cache.size`.

deploybot: Received confirmation. Scheduling pin now: `pin runtime canary v3.1.8 --until 2026-11-03T06:30Z --scope eu-west,staging --created-by alicia`

deploybot: Pin created ✅. Rollback guard: auto-unpin scheduled at 2026-11-03T06:30Z. Alerting channel #eng-oncall if kv.cache.size > 80% of node memory for >5m.

oncall-rot1: Acknowledged. I'll add a dashboard quicklink and a pager rule. Leaving a postmortem template ready in case the runtime patch regresses further.

mike: I'll start the v3.2.2 branch and include the extra unit + integration tests. Tagging @sarah for canary verification after fix.

sarah: Thanks — will run a canary QA sweep once v3.2.2 is in CI. If green, we can unpin immediately and allow SDK hotpatch to go to full canary. :shipit:

alicia: Thanks everyone. Filing release note snippet: "Temporary canary pin to runtime v3.1.8 due to KV cache compaction regression in v3.2.1 — scheduled auto-unpin 6h; runtime patch in flight."

mike: leaving a comment on the SDK PR to reference this thread and the pin ID: 6798765432.
